name: Window Switcher
author: cllpse
description: A macOS-style window switcher: hold SUPER and tap TAB to cycle a horizontal strip of open windows, or throw the pointer into any corner of the screen to open it with no key held. Click a tile to focus it, drag one onto another workspace to move it there or onto another window to split it above, beside or below, and drag a workspace's handle to re-arrange the workspaces.
